meta.title: Token usage
meta.description: Adds a Token usage page under Settings that totals model token consumption for every session, subagents included, by day, week, and month: overall tokens, input, cache reads and writes, output, call counts, the per-model split, and a per-session ranking. It only reads local session logs — no model calls and no session changes. The first visit backfills past sessions in the background with a progress bar and stores the ledger at $DSH_HOME/token-stats/usage.json; later reads update it incrementally.
